name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport started with a childhood fascination for fixing things. He took apart and reassembled anything he could get his hands on, eventually leading him to study mechanical engineering. After graduating, he worked for several years in automotive manufacturing, but his passion for racing never faded. He started sim racing in his spare time, and his knack for identifying and fixing problems in the virtual world caught the attention of a smaller racing team who offered him a role as a simulator engineer.

Ricardo is meticulous and dedicated, with a keen eye for detail and an unwavering commitment to accuracy. He believes that the simulator is only as good as the data it's fed, and he's constantly striving to improve the correlation between the virtual and real worlds. He is known for his methodical approach to problem-solving and his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the drivers and race engineers. He is well respected within the team for his dedication and experience.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height, with a slightly stocky build and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when concentrating.
